summary: Editas Medicine filed an 8-K to disclose it suspended and terminated the prospectus supplement for its at-the-market (ATM) offering program with TD Cowen. No shares will be sold until a new prospectus is filed and a registration statement is declared effective. The ATM program had already raised $43.9M in gross proceeds from 14.3M shares. The sales agreement remains in effect. This is a routine administrative event, not a special situation.
